title: Security scrub & handoff notes — July 18 2026
content:
Meeting: Security scrub + handoff (weekly sync) — 2026-07-18 10:00-10:45 PT
Attendees: Evelyn Chen (owner), Mateo Alvarez, Priya Kapoor, Jordan Blake, Samira Rao, (notes to self: invited Dave for SRE, he couldn't make it)
Goals: quick status of open findings, decide immediate rotations, capture threat-model notes for upcoming Private VPC peering work, assign owners for runbook updates and JIRA tickets.

1) Quick summary of active findings
- SEC-1021 (internal): stale service account token found in infra/bootstrap script — discovered by secret-scan alert 2026-07-16. Exposure window: ~3 days. Impact: high for infra provisioning.
  - Root cause notes: token was added in commit abc1234 during experimental autoscale gating; token was never rotated. Commit referenced by GH PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/987.
  - Immediate mitigation: revoke token + blocklist (Mateo, due 2026-07-18 EOD). Rotate any dependent ephemeral credentials (Jordan to confirm list, due 2026-07-19).
  - Postmortem stub: create SEC-1021-postmortem doc and attach timeline (Evelyn).

- SEC-1032 (external report): Slack webhook URL embedded in an old integration repo. Exposure window: historically unknown. Severity: medium
  - Decision: rotate webhook and re-instrument via secrets manager (Priya to rotate + re-create integration, due 2026-07-20).
  - Notes: flagged to product team owning the integration — linked JIRA created and owner pinged.

- Code scanning noise: a cluster of false positives from the new regex rule set — causing duplicated alerts.
  - Action: tune secret-scan rules to reduce noise (Samira + infra-tooling, due 2026-07-25). Add explicit ignore list for third-party vendored deps.

2) Threat modeling excerpt: Private deployment VPC peering (incoming feature backlog)
- Scope: Private customers will request VPC peering between their VPC and Redwood Private control plane layer.
- Topline threats identified in session:
  - Lateral movement risk if customer VPC contains compromised host that has network path to management plane.
  - Misconfigured route propagation allowing cross-tenant access.
  - Overly permissive security groups exposing control-plane endpoints.
  - Secrets exfil via mounted NFS or misconfigured host-level agents.
- Mitigations proposed:
  - Default-deny routing policy + egress-only peering templates (Jordan owner, draft policy by 2026-07-30).
  - Enforce mTLS on control-plane endpoints + client cert rotation cadence (design doc: CON-PEER-MTLS, Priya owner, due 2026-08-06).
  - Harden onboarding checklist: required network ACL review + infra-as-code scan for peering templates (Samira to add checklist step).
  - Add an automated smoke test that attempts a minimal cross-tenant access and confirms failure (SRE to own).
- Open questions (parking lot): how to surface peering risks in the Console early (UX + product). Add to product backlog.

3) Secrets hygiene & automation progress
- Progress: secrets-rotation pipeline MVP is running in staging; rotating long-lived DB credentials on schedule for a subset of services.
- Blocker: key vault API rate limits for mass rotation in Dedicated customers — investigating retry strategy vs staged rollout. Ticket JIRA-OPS-441 created.
- Next step: run a controlled rotation for a Dedicated customer's non-prod environment next week, coordinate with Solutions Eng. (Evelyn to schedule).

4) Runbooks / playbooks / alerts
- Update: incident runbook for leaked secrets (playbook-leak-v2) needs two additions: a) explicit PR/commit search steps, b) guidance for notifying affected customers. (Priya to update by 2026-07-22).
- Create short-runbook for rapid token revocation across clouds (cloud-revoke-cheatsheet). Mateo to draft and test on 2026-07-19.

5) Action items (concrete)
- Mateo: revoke leaked SA token for SEC-1021 + verify nothing else uses it (due 2026-07-18 EOD).
- Jordan: inventory dependent services for rotated tokens; confirm rollback path (due 2026-07-19).
- Priya: rotate Slack webhook + update integration to use secrets manager; update playbook (due 2026-07-20).
- Samira: tune secret-scan rules, add ignore list for vendored code (due 2026-07-25).
- Evelyn: draft postmortem stub and timeline for SEC-1021, schedule 1:1 with infra owner (due 2026-07-21).
- Product/Solutions Eng (action assigned in Slack): workshop on peering UX/console exposure (owner TBD, target 2026-08-02).

6) Notes / discussion snippets (informal)
- "We should treat any long-lived infra token as retired after 7 days unless explicitly documented." — quick suggestion; needs policy discussion.
- Agree that secret-scan false positives are eating attention — tuning is higher ROI than chasing low-confidence alerts.
- Consider adding CI gate to block commits that introduce plaintext-looking secrets to main branches (high friction but strong signal).

7) Follow-ups for next sync (2026-07-25)
- Status on SEC-1021 remediation and postmortem draft.
- Demo of rotation run in Dedicated non-prod.
- Draft of peering default-deny routing policy.
- Secret-scan noise reduction progress.

Parking lot / items for longer discussion:
- Formalize token lifetime policy (policy doc + rollout plan).
- Evaluate vendor for managed secret scanning vs homegrown.

Notes to self: capture command snippets used to revoke tokens, drop into cloud-revoke-cheatsheet doc. Also remember to pull commit blame on abc1234 to confirm author timeline.

End of notes.
